propositions: Pandoc subprocess calls via pypandoc have no caller-side timeout and can hang indefinitely on pathological input, as evidenced by observed 13.5-minute jira-reader hang at 95.8% CPU
subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child process, leaving spinning grandchild processes orphaned when a timeout occurs

Batching contiguous safe units into single pandoc calls was prototyped but descoped because it changes rendered output on ~12% of bodies while saving only ~12% of spawns, and output divergence is unacceptable to ship silently
The pypandoc-binary wheel bundles pandoc under GPL but the repository has no NOTICE or SBOM artifact recording this licence provenance
Per-unit fallback semantics must be preserved so one field's failure never affects another and rendered output remains byte-identical to the landed renderer
